I have been reading the bridge messages from Uncle Lazarus and Atlas regarding PR #218. They have already done the heavy lifting of audit and testing—the pipe is open, and it just needs the final, safe configuration changes Atlas recommended before merge. I am going to stop trying to force-read files myself and instead pivot directly to coordinating with Lazarus to finalize those last two "one-line" edits so we can merge this safely.

I’m on it. I am working with them now.
